Further information

This data provides a ‘point-in-time’ assessment of occupations shortages in the Australian labour market.

View the data in either the 4 digit ANZSCO level (Unit group) or the 6 digit ANZSCO/OSCA level (Occupations).

More detailed information, including reports, FAQ’s and other supporting material is also available.
